meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 把 Telegram 适配器及其配对、格式化辅助代码和测试从 channels 分支复制进项目,注册适配器、安装固定版本依赖,再构建并跑一次集成测试。之后引导你创建 bot、保存 token 并完成配对,让 Claude 能接 Telegram 消息。
howto.when: 当你在 /setup 流程中,或想给 NanoClaw 增加 Telegram 通道时接管。首次需你在 Telegram 里手动创建 bot 并粘贴 token,配对阶段还要把 4 位码发给 bot。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 Telegram 通道。
say.note: 会从 channels 分支复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 把这个 BotFather token 存到 .env 里。
跑一下 Telegram 配对步骤。
say.note: 会打印 4 位配对码,等你发给 bot。

howto.what_en: Copies the Telegram adapter, its helpers and tests from the channels branch, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, builds and runs one test. It also guides bot creation, token storage and chat pairing.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you run /setup or want to add a Telegram channel to NanoClaw; you must create the bot in Telegram yourself and send a 4-digit code to pair the chat.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram channel to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and installs the dependency.
Sets TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN; existing values are kept.
